items.definition:
to need for a particular purpose
This job requires a lot of skill.

set up, found
They plan to establish a new company.

connect, link
I associate that song with my childhood.

cast
The tree cast a long shadow.

to worry, to relate to
His health concerns me greatly.

suggest, offer
I propose we take a short break.

make certain
Please ensure all doors are locked.

to consider or think of in a specified way
I regard him as a friend.

commit
He decided to commit to the project.

determine
We need to determine the cause of the problem.

to fill someone with the urge or ability to do something
Her story will inspire many young people.

estimate
Can you estimate the cost of the repairs?

to organize and carry out; to behave
They will conduct a survey to gather opinions.

to devote (time or effort) to a particular task or purpose
She decided to dedicate her life to helping others.

to stand for or act on behalf of
The lawyer will represent her client in court.

to suppose to be the case, without proof
Don't assume anything; always check the facts.

to happen; to take place
The accident occurred at midnight.

to state officially or publicly
The government declared a state of emergency.

to improve a system or organization by making changes to it
The government plans to reform the education system.

to involve someone in something; to attract and keep someone's attention
It's important to engage students in the learning process.

win a victory over
They managed to defeat their opponents.

make visible or known
The investigation exposed the truth.

disagree with and try to prevent
Many people oppose the new policy.

repeat or copy words from a text or speech
He likes to quote famous authors.

believe to be true or likely; doubt the honesty of
I suspect he is hiding something.

to get, acquire
You can obtain a visa from the embassy.

to make something more difficult or complex
His sudden illness will complicate our travel plans.

to blame someone for something
They accused him of stealing the money.

to tie or fasten something tightly
She used a rope to bind the packages together.

to be entitled to a particular benefit or privilege by fulfilling a necessary condition
You need to pass this exam to qualify for the next level.

to leave (a place, thing, or person) permanently
The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.

to buy or obtain (an asset or object) for oneself
She hopes to acquire a new skill this year.

refuse; decrease
He had to decline the invitation due to a prior commitment.

to remember; to officially order the return of
I can't recall his name right now.

transmit (a program or information) by radio or television
The news will broadcast live at 6 PM.

to state one's intention to harm someone or something
The dark clouds threaten rain.

to bring to an end; to infer
Let's conclude the meeting now.

to point out or show
The signs indicate the way to the exit.

produce or create
The new system will generate more revenue.

encourage or promote the development of
We need to foster a sense of community.

reside or have one's place of business in (a building)
The protesters decided to occupy the square.

temporarily prevent from continuing or being in force or effect
The school decided to suspend the student for a week.

inflict an injury on (someone)
The soldier was wounded in battle.

enable
This new software will enable us to work more efficiently.

to build or create
They plan to construct a new bridge over the river.

to make something unable to function
You can disable notifications in the settings.

to combine or make into a whole
It's important to integrate new employees into the team quickly.

show reverence and adoration for (a deity); treat with adoration
People gather to worship at the temple.

provide with necessary items for a particular purpose
The school aims to equip students with essential skills.

to create or write (a piece of music or writing)
He likes to compose music in his free time.

to carry out or perform (a plan, order, or course of action); to kill someone as a legal punishment
The team needs to execute the plan perfectly.

to defeat or succeed in dealing with
She had to overcome many challenges to achieve her goal.

to arrange in classes or categories
Scientists classify animals into different species.

to follow or chase (someone or something)
He decided to pursue a career in medicine.

to officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose
The area was designated a national park.

to urinate
He had to piss urgently.

to separate
They had to isolate the patient to prevent the spread of the virus.

to change or alter
You may need to modify your plans.

to confirm officially
The doctor will certify your medical condition.

to put a decision or plan into effect
The company decided to implement new safety procedures.

support financially
The company decided to sponsor the local sports team.

to take legal action against a person or institution
They decided to sue the company for damages.

change, transform
They plan to convert the old factory into apartments.

to declare (someone) guilty of a criminal offense by the verdict of a jury or the decision of a judge
The jury decided to convict him of the crime.
